question.text: A portfolio has actual return 18%, β = 1.1, Rm = 14%, Rf = 7%. Jensen's Alpha is:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Required = 7 + 1.1 × (14 - 7) = 7 + 7.7 = 14.7%. Alpha = 18 - 14.7 = 3.3%. **The Trap:** 4% is raw excess (Rp - Rm); 2.3% is miscalculation. **Cross-Exam Context:** CAPM-based alpha; core. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Statistically significant sustained alpha > 0 is rare — treat one year of alpha skeptically.
